title.zh: 平均数、中位数、众数之争 · 三个“平均”三个故事
title.en: Mean, Median, Mode · Three “Averages”, Three Stories

description.zh: 平均数、中位数、众数各回答不同问题；极端值会拉动平均数而几乎不动中位数和众数。数据为示意数据。
description.en: Mean, median and mode answer different questions; an extreme value drags the mean but barely moves the median or mode. The data are illustrative.

label.en: Spread matters as well as centre

reason.zh: 三个“平均”都只描述中心位置；极端值造成的差别说明还需要方差一类的量来描述数据散得多开。
reason.en: All three “averages” describe only the centre; the gaps an extreme value creates show we also need a measure such as variance to say how spread out the data are.

title.zh: 为什么工资用中位数而不是平均数？
title.en: Why are salaries reported as a median, not a mean?

ask.zh: 一个极端大的工资加入后，平均数、中位数、众数哪个动得最多？
ask.en: Add one extremely large salary — which moves most: the mean, the median, or the mode?

ask.zh: 中位数不怕极端值，但它丢失了什么信息？为什么工资报道常用中位数？
ask.en: The median resists extreme values, but what information does it throw away? Why do salary reports prefer it?

reveal.zh: 极端值会拉动平均数，却几乎不动中位数和众数；工资分布右偏严重时，中位数更能代表典型水平。
reveal.en: An extreme value drags the mean but barely moves the median or mode; with salaries skewed high, the median better represents the typical level.
